lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters posterior to the gill slits, showing increased spatial density towards the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting the circular blobs to form a grid-like configuration across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Single dominant horizontal linear feature on the upper flank characterized by a distinct luminance transition from high (superior) to low (inferior).

other_distinctive_markers: A remora is attached to the ventral-posterior edge of the pectoral fin; a high-intensity backscatter point is visible in the water column above the head region.
